description: Each such source's carried `schema` satisfies §3.2's schema-validity gate: every referenced type is defined, every field and argument has a type, no two types or directives share a name and no definition or extension repeats a field or argument name, input positions carry input types and output positions output types, at most one `schema` definition exists and any schema extension extends a defined schema, and the `query` root operation type is present and is an Object type. Every union member and `possibleTypes` entry is an Object type, and no type of a kind other than scalar bears a built-in scalar name.
notes: §3.2 gate 5. An absent mutation or subscription root is not gated (§3.3.1 makes them optional); it is a §5.2.1.1 validation failure handled by §5.
